what_it_is: Allograft implant for intra-articular SI joint stabilization and fusion. Percutaneous delivery through a single needle-like incision. Sterile single-use instrument set. Designed for reproducible intra-articular placement.
indications: Intra-articular SI joint stabilization and fusion.
use_notes: Percutaneous delivery (single needle-like incision) distinguishes from iFuse INTRA. Sterile single-use instrument set promotes procedural efficiency. FEA biomechanics testing showed favorable results vs competitor rectangular ridged allograft (Technical Study 301310-TS).
also_known_as: iFuse INTRA X Allograft Implant System
